buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading and equilibration.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the isotherm.

process_id_metadata.description: Process identifier as recorded in eLabFTW metadata.

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading (as configured in automation script).

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per (ligand, salt) condition.

ligand_name.description: Ligand or protein name whose loading is characterized.

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume per well used for loading.

venting_time_s.description: Venting time configured in the automation protocol.

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for the loading isotherm.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed on resin.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations used.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mg/mL).

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle.

number_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used in the plate layout.

number_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used in the plate layout.

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database.

summary.description: Key metrics aggregated from the analysis script output.

files_processed.description: Number of Tecan data files processed.

n_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations in the analysis.

n_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations in the analysis.

replicates.description: Replicates per (ligand, salt) condition used in analysis.

warnings.description: List of non-fatal warnings raised during analysis.

tecan_metadata.description: Subset of metadata returned by analysis script (e.g. calibration, units).

data_files.description: Paths to processed data files generated by analysis script.

plots.description: Paths to plots generated during analysis.
